name: The Tower of Althalaxx
summary: Delgren the Purifier sends you south from Darkshore into Ashenvale to hunt Ilkrud Magthrull. The orc warlock resides at Fire Scar Shrine, where you are to slay him and recover his tome.

sections.title: A Hunt Into Ashenvale
sections.body: Delgren the Purifier traces the dark cultists at the Tower of Althalaxx to Ilkrud Magthrull, an orc warlock. Ilkrud works from Fire Scar Shrine in southwestern Ashenvale, and Delgren fears his magic could spread through the elven woodlands. He sends you to kill the warlock and take his tome, hoping its contents will reveal his master's designs.

sections.title: The Warlock's Lair
sections.body: At Fire Scar Shrine, Ilkrud keeps company with a summoned succubus and guardian felslayers. Red pillars mark the rocky ascent to the shrine. Once Ilkrud is dead, Delgren can study his tome for the knowledge and commands that connect to the rituals at Althalaxx.

faq.answer: Delgren the Purifier is an Alliance champion at Maestra's Post, a night elf outpost on the border between Darkshore and Ashenvale. He directs efforts against demonic corruption and cultists in the region.

Ilkrud Magthrull is an orc warlock who has made his lair at Fire Scar Shrine in southwestern Ashenvale. Delgren first considered him a minor annoyance, but his ties to the dark rites at the Tower of Althalaxx make him a critical target.

faq.q: Where is the Fire Scar Shrine located?
faq.answer: Fire Scar Shrine lies in southwestern Ashenvale, south of the Shrine of Aessina and west of Astranaar. The corrupted enclave is infested with demons, and two red pillars flank the path to Ilkrud's altar.

faq.q: Why does Delgren need Ilkrud Magthrull's tome?
faq.answer: Ilkrud's tome holds his dark rituals and communications. Delgren hopes to decipher them and discover the plot linking the warlock to the cultists around the Tower of Althalaxx.

faq.q: How does this quest connect Darkshore to Ashenvale?
faq.answer: The investigation begins at the Tower of Althalaxx on Darkshore's northern coast. As the mystery deepens, the cultists' network leads south through Darkshore into Ashenvale's contested forests.

faq.q: What happens after recovering the tome?
faq.answer: Delgren studies the tome to uncover the schemes behind the cultists at the Tower of Althalaxx. His findings lead to the final confrontations in the chain.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer, you travel from Darkshore into the demon-tainted reaches of Ashenvale to confront a growing menace.
As a paladin, you join Delgren the Purifier in fighting fel summoners and taking their corrupt tomes, answering the Holy Light's call against demonic corruption.
As a warlock, you face Ilkrud Magthrull, a fellow practitioner of the dark arts who guards his unholy texts with summoned succubi and voidwalkers.
As a night elf, you defend Ashenvale's ancient forests from the defilement at Fire Scar Shrine by bringing Ilkrud down.
